question: How do I reset my password?
answer: Go to the login page, click 'Forgot Password', enter your email, and follow the instructions in the reset email. The link expires in 24 hours.

question: What payment methods do you accept?
answer: We accept Visa, Mastercard, American Express, and PayPal. All payments are processed securely through Stripe.

question: How do I cancel my subscription?
answer: Go to Settings > Billing > Cancel Subscription. Your access continues until the end of your current billing period. No refunds for partial months.

question: What are your pricing plans?
answer: We offer three plans: Free (up to 3 projects), Pro ($12/month, unlimited projects, priority support), and Enterprise ($49/month, custom integrations, dedicated support).

question: How do I contact support?
answer: Email us at support@example.com or use the in-app chat widget. Business hours are Monday-Friday, 9 AM - 6 PM EST. Pro and Enterprise users get priority response within 4 hours.

question: Can I export my data?
answer: Yes. Go to Settings > Data > Export. You can export in CSV or JSON format. Exports include all your projects, tasks, and settings. Large exports are emailed as a download link.

question: Is there a mobile app?
answer: Yes, we have iOS and Android apps available on the App Store and Google Play. They sync in real-time with the web version.

question: How do I invite team members?
answer: Go to Settings > Team > Invite. Enter their email addresses. They'll receive an invitation link. Free plan allows up to 3 team members, Pro allows 10, Enterprise is unlimited.

question: What happens when my free trial ends?
answer: After the 14-day trial, you'll be moved to the Free plan. Your data is preserved, but you'll be limited to 3 projects. Upgrade anytime to regain full access.

question: Do you offer refunds?
answer: We offer a 30-day money-back guarantee for annual plans. Monthly plans are non-refundable but you can cancel anytime. Contact support@example.com for refund requests.

question: How do I change my email address?
answer: Go to Settings > Account > Email. Enter your new email and verify it via the confirmation link. Your old email remains active until verification is complete.

question: Is my data secure?
answer: Yes. We use AES-256 encryption at rest, TLS 1.3 in transit, and are SOC 2 Type II certified. Data is stored in AWS us-east-1 with daily backups retained for 30 days.
